text:
incidentbot: DETECTED: sustained p95 latency degradation in inference-prod-apac (current p95 ~1.9s, baseline ~320ms). Pager sent to oncall.
jordan: I'm on it. pulling up latest from traces + router metrics. seeing request queue growth and an increase in 5xx downstream errors from kv-cache in ap-southeast1.
oncall-ops: noticed repeated kube restarts on pool-apac-b; kubelet logs show OOMKill on worker processes. starting runbook checklist now.
jordan: quick hypothesis: memory leak in model-worker after recent image rollout + autoscaler attempting to reclaim causing cold-start spikes. immediate mitigations: pin traffic to other apac pools, disable recent image rollout, and enable a circuit-breaker to shed low-priority requests.
infra-bot: creating incident record INC-20260315-APAC-RTG and notifying infra-sig.
elle: proposing customer communication. Draft for status page: "We are investigating elevated inference latency impacting APAC region. Engineers are applying traffic and capacity mitigations; some customers may see improved performance as traffic is shifted. Updates every 20 minutes." recommend adding list of impacted endpoints.
jordan: impacted endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream, embeddings for APAC region. ETA for initial traffic shift: ~10 minutes.
oncall-ops: executing mitigations now:
```
# rollback image for pool-apac-b
redwoodctl machines update --pool=pool-apac-b --image=redwood-worker:stable
# update routing to prefer pool-apac-a then ap-northeast1 fallback
redwoodctl routing set-priority inference-apac --preferred=pool-apac-a --fallback=ap-northeast1
# enable circuit-breaker for low-tier routes
redwoodctl routes update --name=inference-apac --circuit-breaker=enabled --cb-threshold=75
```
jordan: started draining pool-apac-b and rolling back image. also temporarily lowering concurrency per worker from 8 -> 4 for APAC to reduce OOM pressure.
support-lead: prepping customer emails for impacted accounts. Suggested copy for enterprise customers who require geo-only routing:
"We are currently mitigating elevated inference latency in the APAC region by routing requests to alternate healthy zones and applying worker configuration changes. If you require APAC-only routing, please reply to this thread or open a support ticket and we will assist with a preserved-zone failover."
oncall-ops: traffic shift progress: 0% -> 35% -> 70% -> 100% over 7 minutes. Some services reported brief 502s during the swap, roughly 30-60s window.
jordan: metrics update: p95 trending 1.9s -> 1.2s -> 450ms after full shift and rollback. error rates on kv-cache reduced to baseline. memory footprints on pool-apac-b decreasing as workers restart on stable image.
statusbot: Queueing public update: "Mitigation underway  Traffic has been shifted away from affected nodes and a rollback applied; customers may experience brief intermittent errors. Further updates in 20 minutes." link to incident: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260315-APAC-RTG
elle: customer comms published to impacted customers and targeted outreach to 9 enterprise accounts initiated.
infra-bot: applied temporary suppressions for autoscaler churn alerts (window 40m) and enabled additional retention on router traces for deeper analysis.
oncall-ops: handing off to jordan -> ellie at 08:34 UTC. ellie please monitor for regressions and hold on re-enabling default concurrency.
jordan: handing over. watchlist for ellie: any OOMKill in kubelet logs, p95 above 900ms for 5 minutes, and any increase in 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained.
elle: acknowledged. I'm taking over monitoring at 08:34 UTC. will post a summary after 20 minutes.
support-lead: internal note for CS: template to use for account DMs:
"Hi <Customer>, we're mitigating an APAC performance issue by shifting traffic and applying configuration fixes. You may see slightly higher latency; expected improvement within ~20 minutes. If geo constraints are strict for your workload, please reply and we'll arrange a zone-preserved plan."
statusbot: public update posted: "Mitigation in progress  initial rollback and traffic reroute executed. Monitoring for stability." (link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260315-APAC-RTG)
jordan: after 15 mins of observation p95 is steady ~420ms, no new OOMKills reported. preparing a short internal blurb for eng-sig and eng-all with next steps and RCA owners.
oncall-ops: proposed short-term action items: lock worker image to stable on APAC pools, add a pre-deploy memory test to CI for worker image, and add autoscaler cooldown 5m -> 10m. long-term: memory leak root cause investigation and improved circuit-breaker defaults.
elle: preparing RCA owner and timeline: initial RCA draft within 72 hours, detailed postmortem with timeline and action items within 5 business days. assigning RCA to infra-sig lead.
statusbot: final public note queued: "Service is recovering  latency back to expected ranges for APAC. We will keep monitors active and follow up with a post-incident report."
support-lead: confirming customer follow-ups queued and priority enterprise contacts notified.
jordan: closing active paging; switching incident to monitoring mode. please escalate to me directly if p95 > 900ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
elle: taking incident ownership for post-incident actions and RCA. drafting internal comms now with timeline and customer outreach summary.
incidentbot: incident INC-20260315-APAC-RTG moved to monitoring state at 08:40 UTC. all hands clear unless conditions regress.
